baseline_reference.rule: Reference only; pack never replaces existing trusted or vehicle evidence.

claims.exact_claim: The sourced Zoe Phase 1 CanZE catalog defines a broad set of explicit 11-bit ECU request/response pairs including EVC 7E4/7EC, LBC 79B/7BB, ABS 740/760 and UCH 745/765.
claims.action_if_connected: After Zoe Phase 1 classification, prioritize exact catalog routes for presence/identity before bounded enumeration.
claims.promotion_test: Physically inventory at least two Zoe Phase 1 vehicles and bind routes to stable ECU fingerprints.

claims.exact_claim: Zoe Phase 2 uses both explicit 11-bit routes and exact normal-fixed-form 29-bit routes for selected modules including LBC, inverter, ABS and security gateway.
claims.action_if_connected: Enable only the exact 29-bit routes listed in this pack after Zoe Phase 2 classification; never target-range enumerate.
claims.promotion_test: Physically reproduce request/response tuples and read stable identity on a Zoe Phase 2.
claims.non_generalization_boundary: Exact routes do not authorize generic Renault 29-bit enumeration.

claims.exact_claim: The Twingo III Phase 2 CanZE catalog contains a dedicated S-GW3 route 18DAD2F1/18DAF1D2 alongside a large 11-bit route set.
claims.action_if_connected: Use the exact S-GW3 tuple as presence/identity evidence only; do not attempt SecurityAccess.
claims.promotion_test: Confirm on physical Twingo III Phase 2 vehicle.

claims.exact_claim: The immutable OBDb Megane source contains enhanced service-22 chassis/dynamics data on request 740 with response 760, including wheel speeds, steering, odometer and brake-related fields.
claims.action_if_connected: After Megane-compatible platform classification, probe 740/760, capture identity, then execute only scoped candidates.
claims.promotion_test: Validate route, identity, wheel-speed and brake-pressure behavior physically.
claims.non_generalization_boundary: Megane-specific; source year filters must be honored.

claims.exact_claim: The immutable Dacia Duster OBDb signal set contains many enhanced service-22 commands on headers such as 748 and 7E0, but several records omit an explicit response address.
claims.action_if_connected: Keep enhanced commands documentation-only until response IDs are observed or independently sourced.
claims.promotion_test: Capture raw request/response addressing on a physical Duster and create canonical one-pair route records.
claims.non_generalization_boundary: An OBDb request header without response address does not authorize execution.

claims.exact_claim: The 2024 Duster command-support matrix physically reports standard OBD hybrid-related metrics including hybrid battery voltage/current, hybrid mode and battery SOH under source ECU key DB33.
claims.action_if_connected: Treat the metrics as a high-value research lead, but do not construct an active route until DB33 transport/addressing is canonically normalized.
claims.promotion_test: Resolve raw CAN/OBD addressing and reproduce on project hardware.
claims.non_generalization_boundary: One model year/source test architecture; DB33 is not interpreted as a CAN ID by this pack.

claims.exact_claim: Renault identifies Megane E-Tech Electric with CMF-EV and Scenic E-Tech with AmpR Medium, formerly CMF-EV.
claims.action_if_connected: Classify platform confidently but stop at platform_known_route_knowledge_incomplete if no trusted route is available.
claims.promotion_test: Obtain read-only physical diagnostic capture and stable ECU identities.
claims.non_generalization_boundary: Platform identity does not imply Zoe route compatibility.

claims.exact_claim: Renault states Renault 5 and Renault 4 use AmpR Small and describes SWEET400 as part of the platform's electrical/electronic architecture.
claims.action_if_connected: Do not inherit Zoe or CMF-B proprietary routes; record platform-known/route-incomplete state.
claims.promotion_test: Acquire safe physical presence/identity route evidence.
claims.non_generalization_boundary: No diagnostic route claim is made from OEM platform documentation.

claims.exact_claim: Dacia states Duster III uses CMF-B, which had already been used on the latest Sandero, Logan and Jogger.
claims.action_if_connected: Use CMF-B as platform classification evidence; proprietary Duster commands stay model scoped.
claims.promotion_test: Compare ECU fingerprints/routes across at least two Dacia CMF-B models.
claims.non_generalization_boundary: Shared platform is not proof of shared DID decoders.
